entries.text: [CHANGE] API: The experimental search endpoints now clamp batch_size to 1000. #19731 [CHANGE] Configuration: Default --web.external-url to https when --web.config.file enables TLS. #19241 [CHANGE] PromQL: Subquery samples are now included in the query TotalSamples and TotalSamplesPerStep statistics, and SamplesRead now counts reads from subqueries with an @ modifier in range queries. #19165 [CHANGE] Remote write: Stop exposing the deprecated prometheus_remote_storage_metadata_total, prometheus_remote_storage_metadata_failed_total, prometheus_remote_storage_metadata_retried_total, and prometheus_remote_storage_metadata_bytes_total metrics for Remote Write 2.0 queues. #20080 [CHANGE] Remote write receiver: Count Remote Write 2.x samples and histograms ingested without metadata in prometheus_api_remote_write_without_metadata_appended_samples_total even when metadata-wal-records is disabled. #19812 [CHANGE] TSDB: Reject exemplars whose label names are not unique, instead of storing them and serving a duplicate JSON key from /api/v1/query_exemplars. #19896 [FEATURE] API: Allow overriding PromQL Start Timestamp processing on a per-query basis using the X-Prometheus-Use-Start-Timestamps HTTP header. #19066 [FEATURE] Agent: Support metadata-wal-records in Prometheus Agent mode. #19684 [FEATURE] PromQL: Add experimental integral() function for computing integral-over-time of range vectors behind the --enable-feature=promql-experimental-functions flag. #14440 [FEATURE] PromQL: Add expe

entries.text: [SECURITY] Container images: Update CA certificates to distrust "emSign ECC Root CA - G3" and "Comodo AAA Services root" following the compromise of eMudhra intermediate CA private keys. [SECURITY] Build with Go 1.27.3 to fix vulnerabilities in net/http, net/textproto, crypto/tls and html/template. [SECURITY] Bump golang.org/x/net to v0.60.0 to fix HTTP/2 vulnerabilities (GO-2026-6603, GO-2026-6610, GO-2026-6611, GO-2026-6612, GO-2026-6617).
